title: The Brothers - Celebrating the Allman Brothers Band 50th Anniversary
original_title: The Brothers - Celebrating the Allman Brothers Band 50th Anniversary
overview: Celebrate 50 years of the Allman Brothers Band’s music with Jaimoe, Warren Haynes, Derek Trucks, Oteil Burbridge and Marc Quinones. They’re joined by Reese Wynans, Duane Trucks and Chuck Leavell in this 2020 Madison Square Garden concert. Performances include signature classics “Statesboro Blues,” “No One to Run With,” “Midnight Rider,” “Trouble No More,” “Melissa,” “Come and Go Blues” and more.
